name: Robin Carolan
biography: Robin Carolan is a British-Irish film composer, music producer and curator. For 10 years, he was responsible for the acclaimed leftfield electronic record label Tri Angle and has collaborated with artists including Björk, Vessel, Lyra Pramuk, and serpentwithfeet. In 2022, he debuted as a film composer, working with Robert Eggers on the Viking epic, ‘The Northman’. He also scored for Robert Egger’s reimagining of the silent horror classic, ‘Nosferatu’. Information above via their homepage.
